provenance.review: machine-checked by lab.tools.check_registry (verbatim quotes, sections, ids); interpretations are unreviewed drafts (interpretation_status per requirement)

draft_notes: Only the supplied document was used. The document declares dependencies on DKP-0-ORACLE-001, DKP-1-IDENTITY-001, DKP-1-IMPACT-001, and DKP-2-ECONOMIC-001; their contents are not supplied. Provision-level dependencies identify explicitly invoked protocols, including the Physical Truth Layer mapped by the dependency list to DKP-0-ORACLE-001. PPDI aggregation, thresholds, RED computation, and several qualitative classifications are unspecified. Sections 2 and 12 contain no independently testable operative provisions. Section 8 is ambiguous about whether 'as primary tools' qualifies all three rejected tools or only punitive enforcement. Defense and Crisis protocols are referenced without document ids.

requirements.title: Regulate Transport Environment Rather Than Driving
requirements.quote: This protocol does not regulate driving behavior directly. It regulates the physical and economic environment in which transport choices occur.
requirements.interpretation: Check whether measures issued under this protocol concern the physical or economic transport environment and avoid direct regulation of driving behavior. Distinguishing environmental incentives from direct behavior regulation requires a declared classification.
requirements.criterion: Measures regulate the physical and economic transport environment without directly regulating driving behavior.
data_dependencies: transport policy measures and their effects
requirements.gap: The boundary between direct driving regulation and environmental intervention is undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A rule distinguishing direct driving regulation from environmental intervention.

requirements.title: Require Preferable Safe Transport Modes
requirements.quote: Safe modes of transport MUST be physically and psychologically preferable to dangerous ones.
requirements.interpretation: Compare safe and dangerous modes on physical and psychological preference. The text supplies neither mode risk categories nor a preference measure or population aggregation rule.
requirements.criterion: Safe modes are preferable to dangerous modes on both physical and psychological grounds.
requirements.gap: Risk classification, preference measurement, and population comparison rules are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Definitions of safe and dangerous modes.
A method for comparing physical and psychological preferences across Subjects.

requirements.title: Exclude Dignity Sacrifice From Viable Equilibria
requirements.quote: Safety that requires sacrifice of bodily dignity is not adopted at scale and SHALL NOT be assumed as a viable equilibrium.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect behavioral models and planning assumptions for equilibria designated viable despite requiring bodily dignity sacrifice. The assertion about adoption at scale lacks a scale definition and supporting behavioral model.
requirements.criterion: An equilibrium requiring sacrifice of bodily dignity is not assumed viable.
requirements.gap: Bodily dignity sacrifice and equilibrium viability are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Operational definitions of bodily dignity sacrifice and viable equilibrium.

requirements.title: Compute Publish And Audit PPDI
requirements.quote:
The system SHALL compute, publish, and audit a mandatory metric:

PPDI — Passenger Physical Dignity Index
requirements.interpretation: Verify that PPDI is computed and that publication and audit records exist. Checking the correctness of the computed metric requires an aggregation method that this document does not provide; no publication or audit cadence is specified.
requirements.criterion: PPDI is computed, published, and audited.
requirements.gap: Components published; the composite has no formula: UNKNOWN.
hypotheses_needed: A PPDI aggregation method.
The population, reporting scope, and observation period for checking performance of the three duties.

requirements.title: Include Minimum Measurable PPDI Components
requirements.quote: PPDI SHALL include, at minimum, the following Physical Truth Layer–measurable indicators:
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the PPDI specification for seated-trip percentage, minimum guaranteed individual seat width, forced-contact prohibition, vibration and noise thresholds, thermal comfort range, and average crowd density per cubic meter. Additional components are allowed; measurement methods and numerical bounds are absent.
requirements.criterion: PPDI includes every listed component, and each is measurable through the Physical Truth Layer.
requirements.gap: Vibration, noise and thermal comfort are declared inputs.
hypotheses_needed: Measurement procedures and aggregation periods for each component.
Vibration and noise thresholds and a thermal comfort range.
A representation of forced-contact prohibition within PPDI.

requirements.title: Prohibit Forced Nonconsensual Bodily Contact
requirements.quote: - prohibition of forced bodily contact between non-consenting passengers,
requirements.interpretation: Check passenger contact events against force and consent classifications. The list presents this as a PPDI component, leaving ambiguity between an absolute operating prohibition and a requirement to represent prohibition compliance in PPDI.
requirements.criterion: Forced bodily contact between non-consenting passengers is prohibited.
data_dependencies: passenger contact observations and consent evidence
requirements.gap: Forced contact = standing density above a declared threshold.
hypotheses_needed: Operational definitions of forced contact and non-consent.
A declared reading of the prohibition's operational scope.

requirements.title: Classify Transport Below Minimum PPDI
requirements.quote:
Transport modes operating below the minimum PPDI threshold are classified as:

Physically Degrading Transport Modes
requirements.interpretation: Compare each mode's PPDI with the minimum threshold and require the degrading classification when its score is strictly below that threshold. Cost efficiency and throughput cannot exempt a mode; the text does not establish the converse classification rule.
requirements.criterion: If mode PPDI < minimum PPDI threshold, classify the mode as Physically Degrading Transport Modes regardless of cost efficiency or throughput.
requirements.gap: No PPDI minimum in the corpus: UNKNOWN.
hypotheses_needed: A minimum PPDI threshold and PPDI computation method.

requirements.title: Limit PPDI To System Quality
requirements.quote: PPDI is a system quality metric, not a justice or liability score.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect metric definitions and downstream uses to ensure PPDI is treated as system quality and not assigned the role of a justice or liability score. This does not explicitly prohibit every incidental use of PPDI data in another process.
requirements.criterion: PPDI functions as a system quality metric and does not function as a justice or liability score.
data_dependencies: downstream metric use and decision records
requirements.gap: The boundary between informing another process and functioning as a justice or liability score is undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A classification of metric uses as system quality, justice scoring, or liability scoring.

requirements.title: Exclude Standing From Standard Operations
requirements.quote: - Standing passengers SHALL NOT be treated as a standard operating mode.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect operating plans and capacity assumptions for routine reliance on standing passengers. A definition of standard operating mode is needed to distinguish planned exceptions from ordinary service.
requirements.criterion: Standing passengers are not treated as a standard operating mode.
data_dependencies: service plans and capacity planning assumptions
requirements.gap: Standard operating mode is not defined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A rule distinguishing standard operation from exceptional operation.

requirements.title: Restrict Standing To Listed Exceptions
requirements.quote: - Standing transport is permitted only under:
requirements.interpretation: For every instance of standing transport, require emergency conditions, a temporary overload event, or a system recovery state. The text supplies the permitted categories but no criteria for entering or leaving them.
requirements.criterion: Standing transport implies emergency conditions, a temporary overload event, or a system recovery state.
hypotheses_needed: Definitions and start and end conditions for each permitted exception.

requirements.title: Classify Regular Standing As Underprovision
requirements.quote:
If standing occurs regularly, the transport system SHALL be classified as:

Structurally under-provisioned
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate standing occurrence over time and require the specified classification when standing is regular. The text provides neither a frequency threshold nor an observation window.
requirements.criterion: Regular standing triggers classification as Structurally under-provisioned.
requirements.gap: 'Regularly' is a declared share of service hours.
hypotheses_needed: A rule for regular standing, including the observation period.

requirements.title: Trigger Capacity Expansion Or Redesign
requirements.quote: This classification triggers capacity expansion or logistical redesign, not passenger adaptation.
requirements.interpretation: When the system receives the structurally under-provisioned classification, check that it triggers capacity expansion or logistical redesign. Passenger adaptation does not satisfy the required response; no completion deadline is given.
requirements.criterion: Classification as Structurally under-provisioned triggers capacity expansion or logistical redesign rather than passenger adaptation.
data_dependencies: capacity projects and logistics redesign records
hypotheses_needed: Definitions of capacity expansion, logistical redesign, and passenger adaptation.
A method for linking response actions to classification events.

requirements.title: Prioritize Specified Vehicle Interior Features
requirements.quote: Public transport vehicles SHALL prioritize:
requirements.interpretation: Review design decisions for priority given to fully individual seating, passenger separation, staggered or chess-pattern layouts where applicable, and elimination of continuous bench seating on core routes. 'Prioritize' does not unambiguously require every feature in every vehicle.
requirements.criterion: Vehicle design prioritizes all listed features, with layout applicability and the core-route limitation respected.
requirements.gap: Interior layout is a declared input.
hypotheses_needed: A method for checking design priority.
Definitions of spatial separation, applicable layouts, and core routes.

requirements.title: Accept Capacity Loss With Joint Benefits
requirements.quote: Loss of nominal capacity is acceptable where it results in:
requirements.interpretation: Assess whether a capacity-reducing design causes both increased PPDI and reduced dependence on high-risk private transport. The text supplies an acceptance condition but does not explicitly make it the only possible basis for acceptance.
requirements.criterion: Loss of nominal capacity is acceptable where it results in increased PPDI and reduced dependency on high-risk private transport.
requirements.gap: The dependency measure, comparison baseline, and causal attribution method are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A baseline and measure of dependence on high-risk private transport.
A model attributing both benefits to the capacity-reducing design.

requirements.title: Quantify External Harm As RED
requirements.quote:
The Physical Truth Layer SHALL quantify this harm as:

RED — Risk Externalization Delta
requirements.interpretation: Verify that RED quantifies probabilistic external harm associated with every kilometer of private or high-risk transport, including mortality risk, medical system load, infrastructure degradation, and systemic insurance exposure. The text does not provide units, aggregation rules, or a harm model.
requirements.criterion: The Physical Truth Layer quantifies the listed probabilistic external harms of private or high-risk transport as RED.
requirements.gap: RED coefficient declared; ECONOMIC-001 missing.
hypotheses_needed: A probabilistic external harm model and aggregation rule if the referenced protocol is unavailable.
A classification of high-risk transport modes.

requirements.title: Compute Account For And Redirect RED
requirements.quote:
- computed via DKP-0-ORACLE-001 and DKP-1-IMPACT-001,
- recorded as an externality cost,
- redirected to fund high-PPDI transport infrastructure.
requirements.interpretation: Check computation provenance, externality accounting entries, and funding destinations for RED. The computation methods, high-PPDI boundary, and mechanism converting a risk quantity into funding are not supplied.
requirements.criterion: RED is computed via both named protocols, recorded as an externality cost, and redirected to high-PPDI transport infrastructure.
hypotheses_needed: A high-PPDI classification rule.
A mechanism relating computed RED to redirected funding if external protocols do not supply one.

requirements.title: Treat RED As Deterministic Compensation
requirements.quote: RED is not a tax and not a punishment. It is deterministic damage compensation for probabilistic physical harm.
requirements.interpretation: Check the declared economic role of RED and whether identical complete computation inputs yield identical compensation. The text does not define a substantive test distinguishing damage compensation from a tax or punishment.
requirements.criterion: RED is deterministic damage compensation for probabilistic physical harm and is not classified or implemented as a tax or punishment.
hypotheses_needed: A substantive classification of compensation, taxation, and punishment.
A complete input specification for testing determinism.

requirements.title: Condition Optional Identity Risk Modulation
requirements.quote:
RED computation MAY include Identity-bound risk modulation via DKP-1-IDENTITY-001, where:

- risk reduction is supported by PTL-confirmed data,
requirements.interpretation: Identity-bound modulation is optional. When it is used, verify linkage through the named identity protocol and Physical Truth Layer confirmation supporting risk reduction.
requirements.criterion: If identity-bound risk modulation is used, it operates via DKP-1-IDENTITY-001 and risk reduction is supported by PTL-confirmed data.
requirements.gap: The identity mechanism and standards for PTL confirmation of risk reduction are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Evidence validation and identity linkage rules if the referenced protocols are unavailable.

requirements.title: Reduce RED For Lower Impact Profiles
requirements.quote: - Subjects with demonstrably lower impact profiles generate lower RED,
requirements.interpretation: When identity modulation is used, compare demonstrated impact profiles and their RED values. The comparison baseline and whether travel distance and other conditions must be held equal are unspecified.
requirements.criterion: Demonstrably lower impact profiles generate lower RED within identity-bound risk modulation.
requirements.gap: Impact profile ordering, comparison conditions, and the modulation function are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A rule ordering impact profiles.
Comparable travel and exposure conditions.
A modulation function preserving the required lower-impact, lower-RED relation.

requirements.title: Exclude Moral Reputation And Intent Weighting
requirements.quote: - no moral, reputational, or intent-based weighting is permitted.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the identity modulation model's inputs, transformations, and weights for prohibited bases. A feature taxonomy is needed to identify indirect or proxy use.
requirements.criterion: Identity-bound RED modulation contains no moral, reputational, or intent-based weighting.
data_dependencies: identity modulation model and feature provenance
hypotheses_needed: A classification of model features and transformations by prohibited weighting basis.

requirements.title: Exclude Behavioral Enforcement From Incentives
requirements.quote: This mechanism creates an economic incentive for skill, safety, and risk mitigation without behavioral enforcement.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the identity risk incentive mechanism for behavioral enforcement measures. The text does not define whether any economic consequence could itself count as enforcement.
requirements.criterion: The economic incentive mechanism operates without behavioral enforcement.
requirements.gap: The boundary between an economic incentive and behavioral enforcement is unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A definition distinguishing incentives from behavioral enforcement.

requirements.title: Reject Prohibited Equilibrium Shift Tools
requirements.quote:
- bans,
- moral pressure,
- punitive enforcement as primary tools.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the transport strategy for use of the listed tools. The grammar permits either an absolute rejection of bans and moral pressure with a primary-tool restriction on punitive enforcement, or a primary-tool restriction applying to all three.
requirements.criterion: The strategy complies with the stated rejection of bans, moral pressure, and punitive enforcement as primary tools.
hypotheses_needed: A declared grammatical reading of the primary-tool qualification.
A classification of tools and their primary or secondary roles.

requirements.title: Model Comfort Driven Demand Decline
requirements.quote: private high-risk transport demand declines organically, including among high-income Subjects.
requirements.interpretation: Test the stated behavioral implication that seated, predictable, calm, physically dignified public transport leads to declining private high-risk demand, including among high-income Subjects. This is a qualitative dynamic relationship, with no magnitude or time horizon supplied.
requirements.criterion: When public transport is seated, predictable, calm, and physically dignified, private high-risk transport demand declines organically, including among high-income Subjects.
requirements.gap: An empirical claim the behaviour model assumes: UNKNOWN.
hypotheses_needed: Definitions of the four public transport conditions and organic demand decline.
An income stratification and observation horizon.
A model linking improved conditions to demand.

requirements.title: Include Biosphere Impacts In Evaluation
requirements.quote:
- transport-related impacts on biosphere indicators (B(t))

  SHALL be included in system evaluation,
requirements.interpretation: Inspect system evaluations for inclusion of transport-related impacts on B(t). The document names the indicator family but does not specify its members or transport attribution method.
requirements.criterion: System evaluation includes transport-related impacts on biosphere indicators B(t).
requirements.gap: B(t), transport attribution, and the required evaluation coverage are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A biosphere indicator set and transport attribution method.
A definition of sufficient inclusion in system evaluation.

requirements.title: Measure Biosphere Impacts Through Oracle
requirements.quote: - these impacts SHALL be measured via DKP-0-ORACLE-001,
requirements.interpretation: Check measurement provenance for transport-related biosphere impacts. Full compliance requires the measurement rules of the referenced protocol, which is not supplied.
requirements.criterion: Transport-related biosphere impacts are measured via DKP-0-ORACLE-001.
data_dependencies: oracle biosphere impact measurements and provenance
requirements.gap: The referenced oracle measurement protocol is absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Oracle measurement and provenance validation rules if the referenced protocol is unavailable.

requirements.title: Make Biosphere Impacts Influence Decisions
requirements.quote: - and SHALL influence funding, prioritization, and redesign decisions.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect all three decision processes for operative use of measured transport-related biosphere impacts. Merely storing the measurements need not establish influence; no weight or tradeoff rule is specified.
requirements.criterion: Transport-related biosphere impacts influence funding, prioritization, and redesign decisions.
requirements.gap: The minimum evidence of influence and the decision tradeoff rules are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A test of operative influence in each decision process.

requirements.title: Reduce Private Kilometers Without Prohibition
requirements.quote: - private vehicle kilometers decrease without legal prohibition,
requirements.interpretation: Treat this as one component of the listed effectiveness criteria and compare private vehicle kilometers over time while checking applicable prohibitions. The scope of legal prohibition could mean all relevant prohibitions or only prohibitions producing the decrease.
requirements.criterion: Private vehicle kilometers decrease without legal prohibition.
requirements.gap: The comparison period, geographic scope, and relationship between prohibition and the decrease are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A comparison baseline, period, and geographic scope.
A declared interpretation of 'without legal prohibition'.

requirements.title: Require Structural Road Mortality Decline
requirements.quote: - road mortality declines structurally, not episodically,
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate mortality history for a structural decline as part of effectiveness assessment. The text does not choose between counts and rates or define a structural rather than episodic change.
requirements.criterion: Road mortality exhibits a structural decline rather than an episodic decline.
requirements.gap: The mortality measure, analysis period, and structural change criterion are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A mortality measure and observation period.
A model distinguishing structural decline from episodic variation.

requirements.title: Increase PPDI Year Over Year
requirements.quote: - PPDI scores trend upward year-over-year,
requirements.interpretation: Compare annual PPDI scores as part of effectiveness assessment. 'Trend upward year-over-year' could require an increase in every annual comparison or a positive trend across annual observations.
requirements.criterion: PPDI scores trend upward year-over-year.
requirements.gap: The score aggregation scope, assessment span, and strict-increase versus overall-trend interpretation are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A consistent annual score aggregation scope.
A choice between strict annual increases and a positive trend over annual observations.

requirements.title: Require Voluntary Choice Across Incomes
requirements.quote: - public transport is voluntarily chosen across income strata,
requirements.interpretation: Check observed public transport choices and voluntariness within income strata as part of effectiveness assessment. The text does not define the strata, required uptake, or whether 'across' means every stratum or broad representation.
requirements.criterion: Public transport is voluntarily chosen across income strata.
requirements.gap: Income strata, voluntariness, and sufficient uptake across strata are undefined. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: An income stratification and voluntariness rule.
A coverage and uptake interpretation for 'across income strata'.

requirements.title: Decrease Transport Related Biospheric Impact
requirements.quote: - biospheric transport-related impact trends downward.
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate transport-related biospheric impact over time as part of effectiveness assessment. Multiple indicators may move in different directions, and the text supplies no aggregation or trend rule.
requirements.criterion: Biospheric transport-related impact trends downward.
requirements.gap: Indicator aggregation, comparison period, and the downward-trend test are missing. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: An aggregation rule for biospheric impacts.
An observation period and trend criterion.

requirements.title: Preserve Declared System Dependency Position
requirements.quote: DKP-5-TRANSPORT-001 operates:
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the system dependency graph for transport downstream of Physical Truth, Impact, and Identity; upstream of urban planning, labor mobility, and social systems; and coordinated with economic externality accounting. The text does not define whether these relationships require data flow, decision precedence, or organizational placement.
requirements.criterion: Transport operates downstream of L0 Physical Truth and L1 Impact and Identity, upstream of the listed systems, and in coordination with L2 economic externality accounting.
requirements.gap: Downstream, upstream, and coordination relationships lack interface or precedence definitions. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: An operational interpretation of system dependency direction and coordination.

requirements.title: Prohibit Assignment Of Justice Outcomes
requirements.quote:
This protocol SHALL NOT:

- assign justice outcomes,
requirements.interpretation: Inspect protocol outputs and decisions for assigned justice outcomes. Classification requires a definition of justice outcomes, which this document does not provide.
requirements.criterion: The protocol assigns no justice outcomes.
hypotheses_needed: A definition of justice outcomes applicable to protocol outputs.

requirements.title: Prohibit Restrictions On Individual Freedoms
requirements.quote: - restrict individual freedoms,
requirements.interpretation: Evaluate protocol measures for restrictions on individual freedoms under the governing 'SHALL NOT' clause. The text supplies neither a freedom set nor a rule distinguishing restrictions from economic consequences.
requirements.criterion: The protocol does not restrict individual freedoms.
data_dependencies: implemented measures and their effects on Subjects
requirements.gap: The protected freedoms and the test for a restriction are unspecified. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: A defined set of individual freedoms.
A rule for determining whether a measure restricts a freedom.

requirements.title: Preserve Defense And Crisis Protocol Precedence
requirements.quote: - override Defense or Crisis protocols.
requirements.interpretation: Check conflict resolution and execution records to ensure transport rules do not override Defense or Crisis protocols. The referenced protocols have no supplied ids or contents.
requirements.criterion: Transport protocol rules do not override Defense or Crisis protocols.
requirements.gap: Defense and Crisis protocol identities, contents, and conflict semantics are absent. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Identification of the applicable Defense and Crisis protocols.
A rule for detecting overrides and resolving protocol conflicts.
